dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: S—So it's possible to win this way... Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: This game is mine to lose!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: How in Teyvat could you see through other people's tactics?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Well done! Thanks for the game!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope you succeed.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Thank you. I will definitely make it, just like the Dawn Knight from Ballads of the Squire...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Have you read this book? I've finished it so many times! If you've got the time, you should definitely give it a read.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Do you need something? Sorry, I'm all sweaty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What sword style is that?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Oh... I'm copying Master Jean's technique.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Every time she wields her sword... You just know it's a Grand Master at work.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Only those of great character can use a sword fighting style like that, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: It seems like I can't just focus on power training. I need to start building character, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you're with the Knights of Favonius?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Who, me? You think I have what it takes? Really!?

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Yay, woohoo! My training must really be working after all.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Actually I'm not a knight yet, but I'm confident I will make it through the tryouts.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Then I'm gonna climb the ranks to captain, then get promoted to Master Jean's second-in-command, and when Jean gets to retirement age, she will shake my hand and say...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: ...Whoops, I'm getting ahead of myself! Anyway, watch this space 'cause I'm gonna outdo my feckless father by a long way, that's for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry for bothering you.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Oh it's no problem. I'm going to carry on with sword practice now, so keep your distance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: It's very scary, but I'm actually not all that worried.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: I believe that Master Jean will protect us, and all of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I too were a member of the Knights. I do wish that I could fight alongside Master Jean...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: It's just as I thought. Even Stormterror couldn't stand against Master Jean!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Even though Jean said that that traveler was a big help to her, I'm sure she was just being modest. She must've done the lion's share of the work!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: If only I could have fought alongside Master Jean! We would have vanquished Stormterror together, and then, at the award ceremony, she would have looked at me with a smile on her lips...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Just thinking about it makes my heart soar...

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Yes, I must take this chance and train hard before the next crisis comes...
